title: Revolutionary Activities (1905-1917)
definition: A militant nationalist movement characterized by the belief that political independence could only be achieved through individual heroism, armed struggle, and the elimination of oppressive colonial officials.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the radicalization of the Indian National Movement, the failure of constitutional agitation, and the ideological shift towards mass mobilization.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Revolutionary Activities.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
